# Third-party app icons

These icons are used only to identify the apps listed in the patches README.
They are the property of their respective app developers and are not covered
by this repository's GPL-3.0 license.

Icons are downloaded from Google Play by
`.github/scripts/generate_patches_readme.py` and cached here. To pin or replace
an icon, add `<package>.png` (or `.jpg`, `.jpeg`, `.webp`, `.svg`) to this
directory. Set `NO_ICONS=1` to skip network access.
